The '''Battle of Ord Vaug''' was a battle fought in [[17 BBY/Legends|17 BBY]] during the [[Imperial Era/Legends|reign]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as part of the [[Western Reaches Operation]] of the [[Reconquest of the Rim]], a pacification of [[Separatist holdouts/Legends|Separatist holdouts]] by [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial forces]] directed from the ground by the decorated [[General/Legends|General]] [[Hurst Romodi/Legends|Hurst Romodi]]. Footage of the Battle of Ord Vaug and preceding [[Battle of Kelrodo-Ai]] was captured by [[HoloNet News/Legends|HoloNet News]] crews, making Romodi famous to the citizens of the Empire, while the battle was adapted into an Imperial [[Holodrama/Legends|holodrama]] production.<ref name="Warfare" />
